name: r2-lt-cfgsweep
author: solx-loop
description: A wider cublasLt search than the 8-result heuristic list (heuristic indices with a 32 MB workspace, split-K, reduction scheme, cluster and custom-option overrides) might find >= 4% gains at mid sizes beyond M=25/34/172. The coarse sweep that fit the budget found none, so the final table equals r1b (tile 314 at M 20-48, tile 183 at M 150-200). H14 is neither confirmed nor refuted: the full (tile x custom-option x cluster x split-K x reduction x swizzle) enumeration was not run.
